newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume at 2-mth high on low prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume at 2-mth high on low prices.

text.p: Traded volume on Istanbul's Gold Exchange surged 40 percent from Wednesday to a two-month high of 1,434 kilos on Thursday as lower prices in European markets continued to fuel demand, traders said.
Wednesday's volume was 1,025 kilos and the previous highest was 1,755 kilos on August 27.
Prices were little changed. Gold closed at $380.10 an ounce and 1,175,600 lira per gram, against $381.00 and 1,175,250 lira on Wednesday.
"Some banks took positions and free market traders bought on expectations that ounce prices will recover abroad," said private banker.

"There were also expectations that gold may continue to slide to new support levels which sparked selling. Price margins (when compared to world markets) narrowed due to sales by some banks," he added.
Volume fell to 525 kilos in the second session from 909 in the morning. 80 percent of the total turnover was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
